title: Effects of Ti content on the tensile ductility, lattice distortion and mechanical properties of VNbTaTi*x* refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting furnace in a high-purity argon atmosphere (>99.95%) under an operating current of 400 A, flipped and remelted more than 6 times, rolled into sheets at a rolling speed 150 mm/s, annealed at 1200°C for 45 min followed by water quenching
